# DitherStudio

> Local image dithering for humans and coding agents. Web UI, CLI, HTTP API, Node library.

## Use when

- User wants to dither / 1-bit / halftone / Bayer / Floyd-Steinberg process an image
- An agent needs a deterministic image effect from a CLI or local HTTP call

## Commands

```bash
npm install
npm run dev                          # web studio
npm run cli -- <in> -o <out> [flags] # file dither
npm run serve                        # HTTP API :8787
npm run cli -- algorithms --json
```

## CLI flags

- `-o` output path (required)
- `-a` algorithm: threshold | random | floyd-steinberg | atkinson | jjn | stucki | burkes | sierra | bayer-2 | bayer-4 | bayer-8 | halftone
- `-t` threshold 0-255 (default 128)
- `-p` pixel size 1-32
- `--dark` / `--light` hex colors
- `--invert` `--no-serpentine` `--json`

## HTTP (after `npm run serve`)

- GET /health
- GET /v1/algorithms
- GET /openapi.json
- POST /v1/dither  (multipart file= or raw body)
- POST /v1/dither/base64  JSON { image, algorithm, threshold, pixelSize, dark, light, format }

## Library

```ts
import { ditherFile } from 'ditherstudio'
await ditherFile('in.png', 'out.png', { algorithm: 'atkinson' })
```

## Docs

- AGENTS.md — full agent guide
- README.md — human overview
- /openapi.json — when server is running
